suggested_requirements.text: The system shall search multiple websites for streaming videos and torrents based on a user query.
The system shall allow the user to select whether to search for torrents, streaming videos, or both.
The system shall display search results in tabs categorized by type.
The system shall allow the user to sort search results by name, size, site, or date.
The system shall allow the user to filter search results based on content type or specific websites.
The system shall allow the user to store links to favorite videos.
The system shall allow developers to update the database of searchable websites.
The system shall display torrent search results including website, seeds, peers, size, date posted, and a link.
The system shall display a 'No results were found for this search' message if no results are found.
The system shall provide a page navigation button for search results.
The system shall display video hosting search results including website, full video name, length, and date posted.
The system shall display video link search results including website, show name, episode name, and a link.
The system shall open websites in the user's default web browser via hyperlinks.
Query times shall take no longer than 5 seconds to any website.
Sending the hyperlink to the default browser shall take less than 1 second.
Loading the program shall take less than 10 seconds.
The system shall not display torrent results with 0 seeds.
Sorting results shall take less than 0.1 seconds.
A results page shall display 100 results.
The system shall not display torrent results with a rating of less than 1.
The development team shall investigate each website in the database monthly to ensure no illegal or harmful content is exposed.
The system shall be compatible with Microsoft XP, Vista, Mac OS X, and Linux platforms.
The system shall be compatible with Internet Explorer, Firefox, and Safari browsers.
